title: Fix Common English Mistakes
description: Stop the everyday mistakes native speakers still make: sound-alike words, apostrophes, commas, I vs me, less vs fewer, and more. Short American English lessons you can use in texts, emails and work.

changelog.notes: Initial release - 20 decks, 73 packs, 465 cards: sound-alike words, American usage traps, counting and articles, apostrophes and commas, pronouns, verbs and sentence structure.
